articles.title: PS5 Just Got A PS5 Pro-Like AI Upgrade, But Don’t Expect It Everywhere Yet
articles.summary: The base PS5 console is no slouch when it comes to games, but compared to the PS5 Pro, it doesn't pack the same visual punch. That could change soon, as Sony has unveiled a new AI-upscaling upgrade for the older machine called Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR).
body: "QSSR adds more pixel-level clarity and stability to our environments, bringing out extra detail amidst the busy streets of Madripoor, the dense alleyways of Shinjuku, and many other areas across Logan's epic journey. It’s a perfect companion to the launch of Marvel's Wolverine, and it brings a great taste of the PS5 Pro experience to our players on PS5," head of technology at Insomniac Games, Mike Fitzgerald, wrote in a PS Blog post.

Jasmin Patry, lead rendering engineer at Ghost of Yotei developer Sucker Punch Productions, added that QSSR excels at "resolving the fine details" in characters and environments that previously wasn't possible on the base PS5. Both PS5 exclusives are receiving a patch today to add QSSR as an additional graphics option, and Sony says it will be offered to all PlayStation developers soon.

articles.title: 'These Jobs Are Not Easy': Ex-Star Wars Boss Kathleen Kennedy Admits 'Relief' After Leaving Lucasfilm, Following Turbulent 14-Year Tenure
articles.summary: Lucasfilm veteran Kathleen Kennedy has admitted she feels "a bit of relief" after stepping down from her role as the boss of Star Wars, following a long and often tumultuous run.
body: Kennedy took Lucasfilm's helm in 2002 directly from Star Wars creator George Lucas, and oversaw the studio as it was sold to Disney, produced a new trilogy of mainline movies, and expanded its storytelling via an array of series on Disney+.

Some of these projects have been hugely successful, such as early seasons of The Mandalorian and the critically-acclaimed Andor. And while the Star Wars sequel movies ended in a firestorm of fan backlash and disappointment, they still raked in billions of dollars.

At the same time, numerous Star Wars projects have flopped hard — or simply failed to get off the ground. Solo was a commercial disaster and also messy behind the scenes, as acclaimed directors Phil Lord and Chris Miller (The Lego Movie, Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse) were ditched mid-way through filming. Gareth Edwards was reportedly replaced for Rogue One: A Star Wars Story reshoots, while Colin Trevorrow was replaced during the development of Episode 9.

articles.title: The Xbox Cloud Gaming Controller Is Dead, Apparently
articles.summary: Microsoft agreed to several big changes to appease regulators in its effort to get the blockbuster $75.4 billion deal to buy Activision Blizzard approved, including tweaks to its cloud-gaming projects.
body: A spokesperson for Microsoft denied that the controller concept was abandoned due to the regulatory process, but did not provide a reason.
Microsoft never formally announced or unveiled any controller for cloud gaming, but an image of it leaked this year, prompting raised eyebrows for its... unique design.

Microsoft cut deals with a variety of companies--including Ubisoft, Nware, EE, Boosteroid, Ubitus, and Nvidia --to help mitigate concerns from the UK's Competition & Markets Authority (CMA) that Microsoft might give preferential treatment to its own cloud gaming networks.
Former Xbox CEO Phil Spencer, who led Xbox during the sale process, said such deals freed up one of the concerns the CMA had and helped bring more games to more people.

And as for what's inside, it's packed with information including behind-the-scenes details about the making of the game; concept art; character sketches; insights into its development, like breaking down its narrative and gameplay system; and much more.

That's an exciting amount of detail to dig into, plus a lovely hardcover casing surrounding it all. articles.title: 007 First Light's First DLC Out Now, Adds New Game Plus
articles.summary: 007 First Light launched earlier this year with the promise of future content being added to the TacSim mode, and IO Interactive has finally followed through. The 007 First Light Extended Operations DLC launches for free today, and adds five different missions to the TacSim mode, along with New…
body: Four of the new operations will revolve around the Valhalla, the supercar you get to play with in the campaign, like, once. According to the trailer, these Valhalla missions look like driving trials, where you'll use the car's weapons and gadgets to complete challenges on a timer. Unfortunately, you won't be able to just substitute it into other missions where you have to drive decidedly less exciting vehicles – at least not yet.

IO Interactive also added a New Game Plus mode, and that's probably what I'm going to be diving into first, especially with the path tracing update that came out a couple weeks ago. The mode also bring along a new 00 difficulty, which is supposedly significantly harder than the Purist difficulty in the original game. Enemies are going to react faster, some NPCs are swapped for more difficult variants, and combat is going to be way more unforgiving with two-hit kills and a tighter parry window.

Beyond the content additions, though, IO Interactive is also improving weapon animations and enemies will now be able to throw you off of a cliff, just like you were able to do to them in the base game. It's only fair, after all.

articles.title: GTA 6 Gets Official ESRB Rating and It's as Mature as You'd Expect
articles.summary: In the most obvious turn of events, GTA 6 has officially been rated M for Mature by the ESRB, and it will of course include nudity. Rockstar has added the official ratings for GTA 6 to the various store pages for the game, giving us some insight into what we can expect.
body: The UK equivalent of the ESRB, PEGI, has issued a similar rating of PEGI 18. We're still waiting for the ESRB to post its more in-depth breakdown, which often provides specific references to scenes and content in games alongside its more general description. Those breakdowns hint at certain story elements and gameplay mechanics, so we may hear more about the kinds of sexual content and the level of violence when that becomes available. Fans have been speculating about whether or not Jason and Lucia will have sex on-screen in GTA 6, for example, so it's possible that the ESRB's detailed breakdown will confirm or squash that speculation.

Rockstar previously got into trouble back in the mid-2000s with the release of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, as the game had an interactive sex mini-game buried in its files. The mini-game was cut from the final game, but modders were able to add it back in. As a result of the "pornographic" content, the ESRB re-rated the game to an AO rating, effectively banning it from retailers. This led to a brief recall of the game and scrutiny from government officials.

articles.title: Gears Of War: E-Day Has A Clever Solution To One Of PC Gaming’s Biggest Annoyances
articles.summary: Early access for Gears of War: E-Day has kicked off for anyone who bought the Premium Edition, and if you're on PC, you're probably dreading the traditional shader compilation wait that comes with it.
body: Called Advanced Shader Delivery (ASD), it addresses how modern games rely on shaders to calculate how light, shadows, reflections, and textures should look on screen. This usually involves you sitting for a while when you first boot up a game after installing it, resulting in the infamous "Compiling Shaders" loading bar. In comparison, ASD is like buying a Gundam model kit that's already assembled, right out of the box.

ASD pre-translates and delivers shader files directly to your device ahead of time, so you wait mere seconds. It also works across a wide variety of systems, and while I haven't installed Gears of War: E-Day on my main PC yet, I did load it up on my Asus Xbox ROG Ally X. The shader compilation waiting time was around 20 seconds, far better than waiting up to 15 minutes as I've experienced with other new games.

articles.title: GTA 6 Doesn’t Compromise Scale For Detail, Rockstar Says
articles.summary: Rockstar's games are known for their impressive attention to detail, along with their massive scopes, and GTA 6 is seemingly going to up the ante in that regard. Rockstar boss Aaron Garbut said in an interview that a developer might compromise scale for detail or detail for interaction "but not…
body: "We went the other way," he told Game Informer. "Everything is dialed up--detail, scope, breadth, scale, interaction, and density." He went on to say Rockstar has never "created anything close to this before."
"As the pressure for us on this project is huge, we dealt with that by doing our best to overdeliver," Garbut said.

No game can have everything, though, and GTA 6 is no different. The game takes place in Florida stand-in Leonida but doesn't feature Walt Disney World, for example, but Rockstar says the game will deliver the "full Florida experience."
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game has reportedly already sold close to 6 million copies, generating more than $570 million in pre-sales.

articles.title: Ruriko-ji Temple location in Forza Horizon 6
articles.summary: Ruriko-ji Temple is one of the many landmarks and photography locations in Forza Horizon 6, and it's also featured in a few Festival Playlist challenges, like the #TempleVantage photo challenge in the "British Automotive" series.
body: As the Forza Horizon 6 map is huge, it can be quite difficult to find any landmark, let alone a temple in the woods. However, don't let that sway you from visiting Ruriko-ji Temple, as it's one of the best photo locations to show off your car.
Ruriko-ji Temple is located in the northwest corner of the Minamino region, just south of the farms at the top of the area.

Ruriko-ji Temple is an easy landmark to miss, as there aren't many races or challenges nearby. The easiest way to get there is to follow the off-road trail on the west side of the Naruo Golf Course all the way up until you eventually hit the temple. However, if you've already been to the temple, you can fast travel to any road near it instead to save some time.

While you're here, make sure to take a photo of the temple to earn credit for it in the Photography section of the Discovery journal. However, make sure you're taking a photo of the temple, rather than the pagoda beside it, or else you won't receive credit.

articles.title: A 21st-Century Monster Masterpiece Will Return to Theaters in Glorious 4K
articles.summary: One of the best films from acclaimed director Bong Joon Ho is returning to the big screen. The Host is getting a 4K remaster that's coming to theaters on Nov. 20, 2026.
body: The Host follows Gang-du (Song Kang-ho), a food stand worker who witnesses a massacre as a giant amphibian monster emerges from the Han River and attacks several bystanders, including his daughter. As the victims lie shell-shocked, the government announces that the monster is the host of an unidentified virus and quarantines the area. Then comes an unexpected twist. Gang-du inexplicably receives a call from his daughter, whom he thought was dead. The man resolves to find the monster and rescue his child while evading the government quarantine.

The Host was Bong's third feature-length film, following 2000’s Barking Dogs Never Bite and 2003’s Memories of Murder. This monster movie provided one of the highest-grossing South Korean pictures ever, making close to $100 million on an 11 billion won (roughly $11 million) budget while helping kickstart global viewership for Bong’s films. The movie received widespread critical praise for its mix of satire, humor, and monster-movie thrills. The Hos t is also known for its biting critique of American imperialism and for working as a 20th-century Godzilla equivalent.
points: One of the best films from acclaimed director Bong Joon Ho is returning to the big screen.
The Host is getting a 4K remaster that's coming to theaters on Nov.

articles.title: Aion 2's imminent worldwide release could be huge as early access founders' packs outsell major games, and player numbers soar
articles.summary: Aion 2's much-awaited worldwide release is days away, following its release in Korea and Taiwan roughly a year ago. Despite this, the MMO has soared - high up Steam's most played game chart.
body: There are two charts that tell a story. The first is Aion 2 hitting the number-one spot on Steam's Top Sellers list. While Aion 2 is generally a free-to-play game, you currently have to buy your way into early access via a one of a few founders' packs. The cheapest of these packs is £18.49 and it comes with a stack of in-game cosmetics and consumables.

It's through these founders' packs that Aion has outsold other major recent releases. By revenue, Aion 2's founders' packs have made more than EA FC 27, Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve, and Gears of War: E-Day this week.

As for how many players are actually jumping into Aion 2 early, the Steam Most Played figures paint an interesting picture. As of writing, the game sits at the number nine spot, above Delta Force and Delta Lock, but not quite pushing past big-hitters like PUBG, Apex Legends, and recent multiplayer sensation Wardogs.

This is already an impressive position to be in, but it's of course expected to climb the ranks further once the game becomes open to non-founders a few days from now - and as it becomes free to play.

articles.title: NFL Star Becomes YouTube Legend After Spending 12 Years on One Minecraft City
articles.summary: For the past 12 years, Mike Tomlin has been leading a double life. Football fans knew him as the head coach of the Pittsburgh Steelers, a role he held from 2007 to 2025.
body: Following an interview with Today in which Tomlin revealed he is a “big Minecrafter,” the former NFL star has now opened the doors to his secret digital paradise. Tomlin has posted a tour of the impressive city he’s been building in the game for 12 years to his new personal YouTube channel. The 19-minute video, the first in a planned series, has already racked up over 750,000 views on YouTube at the time of writing.

You’ll understand why viewers are captivated by it as soon as you watch it. The video is astonishingly wholesome, as Tomlin proudly shows viewers around his city with his son at his side. Tomlin explains that he first got into Minecraft by playing with his kids, and quickly became obsessed with it. He continued building even after his kids flew the nest. It will melt your heart.

articles.title: 007 First Light gets free new DLC today, adding New Game Plus and Photo modes, new TacSim missions and more
articles.summary: James Bond game 007 First Light is getting free DLC today in an Extended Operations update. This adds much-asked-for features to the game - such as New Game Plus, a new harder difficulty mode, a photo mode - as well as more TacSim mission challenges and a couple of game adjustments.
body: Those game adjustments are improved weapon handling "fidelity", a press release says, to give more precision to Bond's movement and weapon behaviour. The other adjustment is enemies are now able to throw you off ledges, rather than this being a move only you can do.
New Game Plus is unlocked once you beat the campaign on any difficulty, and once you unlock it, you'll also unlock the game's new 00 difficulty, which is described as "considerably harder".

"The 00 difficulty mode sharpens combat, stealth, and social encounters alike: enemies react faster to bodies and disturbances, certain guard archetypes are swapped for tougher variants, gadget use is restricted within a guard's line of sight, and combat itself becomes far less forgiving, with two-hit kills, tighter parry and side-step timing, and reduced agency gained in a fight," the press release says.

Meanwhile, the TacSim missions bring the Aston Martin Valhalla back, and challenge you to tear across the Slovakian mountainside in it, at varying times of day, as you try to beat certain timed challenges. You can mount rocket-launchers on the car to help, it seems.

articles.title: Ace Combat 8 developer apologises for Belkan War pre-order backlash, explains why it happened and vows to explore possible solutions
articles.summary: The early access launch of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve kicked off on a down note due to some confusion regarding one of the game's pre-order bonuses. Pre-orders of the flight action game include a copy of 2006's Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War, but early adopters discovered it was not a standalone…
body: Unsurprisingly, players - who paid the Deluxe edition price of £75 / $90 to access the game three days early - were unhappy.
The Ace Combat studio has now responded, offering a much-needed clarification as to why The Belkan War is not a standalone game on Steam - when it is on consoles - and outline next steps.

"Ace Combat Zero, is offered as a pre-order bonus. Due to licensing restrictions and platform-related considerations, it cannot currently be released on Steam as a standalone application," the developer wrote on Steam.

"As a result, we have chosen to make Ace Combat Zero available through Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve. We apologise for any confusion or frustration caused by our failure to clearly communicate this distribution method in advance."

videos.title: Gears of War: E-Day Campaign Review
videos.summary: Gears of War: E-Day reviewed by Ryan McCaffrey on Xbox Series X, also available on PC.
body: "By going back to the beginning, Gears of War: E-Day returns to the heart of this series: Marcus Fenix, Dom Santiago, and a Locust horde that’s as terrifying as it is dangerous. E-Day pulls off the tightrope act of giving us a heartfelt prequel with strong characters even when we know how it ends. On a more mechanical level, it also evolves the enemies, weapons, and combat you’d expect to deliver a Gears of War campaign that stands toe-to-toe with any of the others. It wraps up with 10 years still left to go before Marcus gets tossed in prison ahead of the events of the first Gears of War, so here’s hoping the next one stays in the past for a while longer – and that we don’t have to wait another seven years for it to arrive."
